id: title:dmarchuk:stamp open tracking correlation ids into push payloads

review.posthog_relevance: Adds tests for push notification attribution and payload precedence, dependent on implementation in P1.F2.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F1.H1 contains only implementation and test changes. The supplied observations describe adding assertions for workflow, batch run, and invocation IDs in push payloads and checking precedence of correlation data. These observations establish that the chunk tests a capability dependent on implementation in P1.F2, rather than implementing the capability or changing core,
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not contain the implementation or relevant checks for the attributed capability; it only tests the payload. The tier is assigned based on the presence of implementation and test changes, not the demonstrated benefit of the dependent capability.
